## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Changes in `src/core/` include tests
- [ ] No new dependencies, or they were discussed in an issue first
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots in light and dark, and steps to check them by hand
- [ ] Typing-loop changes: note on how frame time was checked
